simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צֶלַע (Tselaʻ) means Tsela , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 21 14.

definitions.full: H6762. Tsela צֵלַע proper name, of a location in Benjamin Josh 18:28 , A ᵐ5 L Σελα [( ε ) λαφ ]; burial-place of Saul 2Sam 21:14 ( צֵלָֹע ), ἐν τῇ πλευρᾷ ; possinly = Tel Amarna Zilu , so Zim ZA vi. 258 Jastr JBL xi (1892), 105 (Wkl, however, thinks of סלע ).
